b: For today’s prompt, write an existential poem. Wars, disease, and famine can lead to existential threats to people and other living creatures. An existential crisis could stem from entering or leaving a season of life (think younger coming-of-age or middle-age crises). Some people feel existential dread from things like AI, robots, and social media. But don’t discount existential philosophy or optimism.
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at an Existential Poem:

If I think, and therefore am,
what do I think I therefore am,
and am I thinking as I should
and differently than others would,
or would I be, as some might say,
a creature meant to fade away,
it doesn’t mean, as far as this,
that at this moment I don’t exist.
